title: EngineManifest
description: Formal schema for agent sandbox engine manifests.

name.description: Unique canonical identifier of the engine; must match its directory name.

port.description: The primary network port exposed by this engine.

web_url.description: Web entrypoint URL launched by the 'ui' command.

target_file.description: Target container file path where compiled rules are mounted.

host_sources.description: List of host paths scanned for global rules to merge into target_file.

target_dir.description: Container directory where skills are installed or mounted.

catalogs.description: Catalog files scanned for skill definitions (e.g. skills.json).

mounts.description: List of host configuration directories or files to bind-mount into the container if present.
